<div class="accordion-item"><h2 class="accordion-header"><button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#work-acc-summary">Summary</button></h2><div id="work-acc-summary" class="accordion-collapse collapse"><div class="accordion-body">&quot;Alaṅkāraśāstra&quot; is a Sanskrit treatise on poetics and literary criticism written by Mātṛgupta, a renowned poet and scholar of ancient India. The treatise is considered to be one of the earliest and most comprehensive works on poetics in Sanskrit literature, and it has had a significant influence on the development of Indian literary theory. &quot;Alaṅkāraśāstra&quot; covers a wide range of topics related to poetry, including the different types of poetic meters, the structure of poetry, and the use of figurative language in poetry. Mātṛgupta discusses the different types of literary devices and techniques used in poetry, such as metaphors, similes, hyperbole, and allusion.<br><br>The treatise also discusses the importance of emotion and sentiment in poetry, as well as the role of the poet in society. Mātṛgupta argues that the poet should be a master of language and an expert in the use of literary devices, but also that they should be a moral and ethical guide for society.</div></div></div>
<div class="accordion-item"><h2 class="accordion-header"><button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#work-acc-contents">Contents</button></h2><div id="work-acc-contents" class="accordion-collapse collapse"><div class="accordion-body">Alaṅkāraśāstra&quot; is a treatise on poetics and literary criticism written by Mātṛgupta, a Sanskrit poet and scholar. The work covers a wide range of topics related to poetry, including the different types of poetic meters, the structure of poetry, and the use of figurative language in poetry. Here is a more detailed overview of the content of the work: Introduction: &quot;Alaṅkāraśāstra&quot; begins with an introduction in which Mātṛgupta discusses the importance of poetry and its role in society.<br><br>Types of Poetic Meters: Mātṛgupta then discusses the different types of poetic meters used in Sanskrit poetry, such as the Anuṣṭup, the Triṣṭup, and the Jagatī.<br><br>The Structure of Poetry: The treatise also covers the structure of poetry, including the different types of verses, such as the Padya, the Śloka, and the Gadya.<br><br>Figurative Language: &quot;Alaṅkāraśāstra&quot; is perhaps best known for its discussion of figurative language, such as metaphors, similes, hyperbole, and allusion. Mātṛgupta describes the different types of figurative language and explains how they are used in poetry.<br><br>Emotion and Sentiment: The treatise also discusses the importance of emotion and sentiment in poetry, and how these elements can be used to create a powerful impact on the reader.<br><br>The Role of the Poet: Finally, Mātṛgupta discusses the role of the poet in society, arguing that the poet should not only be a master of language and literary techniques, but also a moral and ethical guide for society.</div></div></div>

<div class="accordion-item"><h2 class="accordion-header"><button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#work-acc-contribution">Contribution &amp; Notes</button></h2><div id="work-acc-contribution" class="accordion-collapse collapse"><div class="accordion-body">Alaṅkāraśāstra&quot; has contributed to Sanskrit literature by providing a comprehensive and systematic approach to the study of poetics and literary criticism. It has influenced other works in the field of Sanskrit literature, and its principles and theories continue to be studied and referenced by scholars today. The treatise has helped to shape the understanding of the different elements of poetry, including the use of figurative language and the importance of emotion and sentiment. Overall, &quot;Alaṅkāraśāstra&quot; has had a significant impact on the development of Indian literary theory and has played a key role in shaping the field of Sanskrit literature.</div></div></div>
